runs.text: A program reads the initial balance, an amount to charge and an amount to load, and shows the result of charging, the result of loading and the final balance. Write between 3 and 4 test cases so that any wrong version of the card fails at least one.

hints.text: Write the card's invariant. At which edges can it break?
Look at the table of cases in
You need a charge of exactly the balance, a charge of one more and a negative load.
30, 30 and 10; 30, 31 and 10; 30, 5 and -5, with their answers. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Which case would you add for an error that charged negative amounts?
Wrong versions: it does not allow charging exactly the balance, it allows going negative and it accepts negative loads. Each case of the solution uncovers one.
